headline: Nasdaq rises as SpaceX and Super Micro boost AI appetite
summary: Solid results from SpaceX and Super Micro Computer helped boost investor appetite for artificial intelligence-linked stocks on the Nasdaq.
why: The Nasdaq composite index heavily features major technology and growth companies driving the global artificial intelligence sector.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Strong earnings reports from prominent technology hardware providers drive capital inflows into AI-related equities.

why_moved: Strong earnings announcements from key technology companies renewed enthusiasm for artificial intelligence growth prospects.
